name: ponytail-net
description: Keep C#/.NET changes on the simplest implementation that delivers the whole contract: reuse first, framework facilities second, new code and dependencies last, with lite/full/ultra levels.

interface.longDescription: Steers implementations, bug fixes, refactorings, and reviews in C#/.NET toward the least complexity a maintainer must own while delivering the whole requested behavior. Reuses existing code and framework facilities before adding abstractions or dependencies, applies C#-specific decision rules for async, LINQ and EF Core, caching, and serialization, and finishes with the build and tests the change requires. Levels: lite, full (default), ultra, off.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ponytail-net to make this change with the simplest implementation that keeps the full contract.
